name: FuzzyMatchNode
label: Fuzzy Match
description: Matches rows between a primary data table and a reference data table using fuzzy string similarity on one column each. Outputs the primary rows enriched with the matched reference columns, plus the similarity score.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: PrimaryDataTable
fields.label: Primary Data Table
fields.description: The data table whose rows are enriched with the best reference match.

fields.name: ReferenceDataTable
fields.label: Reference Data Table
fields.description: The data table used to look up matches.

fields.name: PrimaryMatchColumn
fields.label: Primary Match Column
fields.description: The column in the primary table to match on.

fields.name: ReferenceMatchColumn
fields.label: Reference Match Column
fields.description: The column in the reference table to match against.

fields.name: Threshold
fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: The minimum similarity score (0-1) to accept a match. Defaults to 0.7.

fields.name: ReferenceColumnsToInclude
fields.label: Reference Columns To Include
fields.description: Optional comma-separated reference columns to include in the output. Leave empty to include all reference columns except the match column.

fields.name: ScoreColumnName
fields.label: Score Column Name
fields.description: The name of the similarity score column. Defaults to 'MatchScore'.

fields.name: MatchedDataTable
fields.label: Matched Data Table
fields.description: The resulting enriched data table. Unmatched rows include the score column set to 0.
